cohort: The study included 222 adolescent pregnant patients, aged 12-19, who delivered at a tertiary care unit in Namakkal, India between April 2022 and March 2023.
finding: The study identified a high prevalence of adolescent pregnancy with common maternal complications including anaemia (54.02%) and pregnancy-induced hypertension (36.78%), and neonatal issues such as low birth weight (60.79%) and preterm birth (37.25%).
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery was the primary mode of delivery (49.55%), closely followed by caesarean section (46.85%).
